proposition: Melvin-Koushki's papers give Shāhrukh's rule as 807-50/1405-47 (Grammatology), 811-850/1409-47 (Timurid-Mughal) and 1409-47 (New Brethren). The dissertation timeline gives no accession year, has him governor of Khurasan from 799/1397 and in control of Khurasan, Transoxania and Khwarazm by 815/1412.
